title: research:PR-007: Transaksi Murah — Direct RPC Trading engine (Rust + TypeScript)
details:
{
  "findings": [
    "Hybrid architecture: Rust CLI (stateless subprocess) + TypeScript orchestration layer (stateful: failover, fees, risk)",
    "Rust CLI communicates via JSON stdout/stderr — child_process spawn from TypeScript",
    "Private key must be passed via env var or stdin, NEVER as CLI arg (visible in ps)",
    "RPC failover: latency tracking every 60s, circuit breaker if all 3 RPCs fail → PAUSE mode",
    "Priority fees: getRecentPrioritizationFees on specific AMM program accounts (Raydium/Orca)",
    "Fee tiers: low=p25, medium=p50, high=p75, auto=p90 if last 3 blocks >80% full else p50",
    "Simulation-first gate: simulate → validate sim result (err field + log scan for slippage) → execute only if clean",
    "Simulation false positive risk: price moves between sim and execute — use tighter slippage in sim than execution",
    "RPC desync: backup may be 1-2 slots behind — check lastValidBlockHeight, must be within 5 slots of tip",
    "Direct RPC best for high-liquidity pools (Raydium/Orca); fallback to Jupiter for exotic pairs"
  ],
  "counter_arguments": [],
  "unknowns": [],
  "confidence": null,
  "recommendation_for_claude": "Use subprocess (child_process.spawn) for Rust CLI integration. Key decision: private key via process.env, never CLI arg. Simulation gate must check both sim.err and logs array for 'Slippage exceeded'. RPC failover circuit breaker is critical safety net. Build TypeScript modules first (rpcFailover, priorityFeeManager, directRpcTrading, risk_guard), then Rust CLI as a thin wrapper. Tests should mock Rust CLI subprocess to keep unit tests fast."
}

title: PR-007 complete: Direct RPC Trading engine (TypeScript layer)
summary: Built 5 ESM JS modules for direct Solana RPC trading: rpcFailover (latency-sorted failover + circuit breaker), priorityFeeManager (p25/p50/p75/p90 fee tiers), risk_guard (pure validator: 1 SOL gate, 0.25 SOL max, 300bps slippage), directRpcTrading (simulation-first orchestrator), skill_registry. 33 tests pass. DRY_RUN=true and LIVE_TRADING=false hard-gated. Rust CLI path returns rust_cli_not_built when binary missing. Private key via process.env only.
details: Key decisions: (1) Codex MCP sandbox blocked — Claude built modules directly. (2) Rust CLI treated as optional subprocess — graceful fallback preserves TypeScript safety layer. (3) liveTradingEnabled=false in DirectRpcTrading constructor is a hard gate independent of dryRun flag — both must be set to execute live. (4) Simulation validates both err field AND logs array for slippage strings. (5) Circuit breaker activates after 3 consecutive failures per endpoint; PAUSED state prevents blind execution.

    "rpcFailover.js: RpcFailover class with latency-sorted endpoint selection, 60s health loop, circuit breaker (PAUSED state after all endpoints fail 3x)",

    "risk_guard.js: RiskGuard pure validator — 1 SOL minimum balance, 0.25 SOL max trade, 0.05 SOL fee reserve, 300bps slippage cap",
    "directRpcTrading.js: DirectRpcTrading orchestrator — risk check → fee → simulate via Rust CLI subprocess → validate sim result → dry-run or live gate",
    "skill_registry.js: central registry object mapping tool names to module paths"
  ],
